svg.text: GTCRN speech enhancement · streaming ONNX · Raspberry Pi 5 target
EDGE RUNTIME — Raspberry Pi 5 (8 GB) · ARM Cortex-A76 @ 2.4 GHz · CPU only · no network
INFERENCE — ONNX Runtime 1.29 · CPUExecutionProvider · opset 11 · INT8
Recurrent state carried per frame — fed back every 16 ms:
Model file: gtcrn_defence.onnx — 48K params, ~1 MB, dynamic INT8 quantised, opset 11 (legacy exporter)
Measured on laptop CPU: 1.53 ms per 16 ms hop = RTF 0.095 · 93% headroom
Streaming reformulation: StreamConv2d / StreamConvTranspose2d with causal caches (no full-buffer reprocessing)
TRAINING — PyTorch 2.13 · Colab T4 GPU · one-time
CC BY 4.0 / CC0 · ESC-50 is CC BY-NC (flagged)
VCTK never seen in training — evaluation only
MAD test split reserved for evaluation
Impulsive oversampled 50% · events placed over voiced speech
Aug: RIR reverb · clipping · band-limit · random gain

g.text: Batch 16 · 4 s segments · per-epoch checkpoint + resume
25 epochs · fine-tuned from pretrained DNS3 weights

svg.text: opset 11 is a hard requirement — the dynamo exporter silently upgrades to opset 18, which benchmarks 3.5× slower and would break real-time on the Pi.

g.text: Streaming output realigned (256-sample lag) before scoring
100 trials per cell · paired on identical clean speech
Published VCTK-DEMAND benchmark — reproduced to 0.02 PESQ

svg.text: Python 3.12 · PyTorch 2.13 · ONNX Runtime 1.29 · onnxsim 0.7.3 · sounddevice / PortAudio · NumPy · SciPy · silero-VAD · pesq · pystoi · torchaudio
